title: Spicy Ethiopian Yellow Pasta
description: A flavorful and spicy Ethiopian-inspired pasta dish featuring yellow rigatoni, rich shiro sauce, and a hint of spice.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the rigatoni according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat. Add the garlic and onion and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the Ethiopian spice blend and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the shiro paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 2-3 minutes.
Add the chopped yellow and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Drain the cooked rigatoni and add it to the skillet with the shiro sauce. Toss to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro.
